meta.resampling_unit: scene (block bootstrap over the 150 nuScenes val scenes)
meta.multiplicity: re-keyed ("T#j"); duplicated scenes are physically duplicated in both GT and predictions, not weighted
meta.pairing: numpy.random.default_rng(b) over sorted val scene names; identical resample across all runs within replicate b
meta.caveat: Evaluation-set uncertainty only. Does NOT estimate training-seed variance; the 3 training seeds are reported separately.

across_seeds.note: With only 3 seeds the smallest attainable two-sided p is 0.25, so a non-significant result here is uninformative about the null; the per-seed bootstrap CIs are the usable evidence for D1.
